methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Solideon is a pre-seed stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Oluseun Taiwo that has raised $6.5M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 10 companies in the robotics and manufacturing sector, including 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private peers such as Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics. However, the peer set lacks sufficient same-stage or valuation-tier comparables to support a reliable median-based approach.

The stage-progression method is applicable and anchors the valuation. Using the $6.5M total raised as a proxy base and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for pre-seed to seed-stage advancement yields $16.25M. This method reflects the capital already deployed and a standard step-up expectation absent further financial or operational data points.

The peer-median approach is not applicable due to insufficient narrow comparables (zero same-stage, one adjacent-stage peer identified; minimum three required). Broader sectoral medians risk introducing bias across heterogeneous company profiles.

The triangulated analysis yields a median valuation of $16M, with a 25th percentile estimate of $14M and a 75th percentile estimate of $19M. This narrow range reflects reliance on a single method. Key uncertainties include current burn rate, revenue traction, technology defensibility, and capital efficiency relative to the peer set—variables that would materially refine the valuation once available.
